title: Annual Pathology Conference of the `Victor Babeș` Institute
html:
Event program

The Annual Pathology Conference of the `Victor Babeș` Institute, Bucharest gathers researchers, clinicians, and industry to advance biomedical science. Sessions highlight basic research, including 3D models for non-communicable diseases, novel animal models, and biomarker discovery, as well as pathology, with emphasis on kidney, gastrointestinal diseases, and oncology, showcasing new diagnostic and therapeutic insights.

Conference abstracts will be indexed in Biomedical Papers – Olomouc, Czech Republic (PubMed, Wos, Scopus and CrossRef indexed)(https://biomed.papers.upol.cz/artkey/inf-990000-0100_About_the_Journal.php).

Abstracts will be submitted in UK English, they must be original and must not have been previously published elsewhere. The accepted format is .DOC. DOCX. Abstract template can be accessed here.

The Conference is CME credited by the Romanian College of Physicians (CMR credits to be announced).

The Conference also hosts an e-Poster session (template).

Registration is closed now

Registration fee (dead-line October 31st): 200 RON for senior researchers and M.Ds and 100 RON for PhD students and early-carrier (resident) M.Ds.

For abstract submission, the payment of the fee will be required after acceptance, in order to complete registration.

For ePoster session, following abstract acceptance and fee payment, the ePoster will be sent as pptx to ipc@ivb.ro.
